title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds flat at 63,104 dollars with a mere 0.1 percent gain, shrugging off fear at a 34 reading while the US session grinds sideways. 

Mempool congestion hits 78,148 transactions yet fees sit at just 1 sat per vbyte, signaling light urgency despite the backlog. Hashrate stands firm at 918.4 EH/s, locking in network security at block 962,768. No major catalysts emerged in the morning window.
